home_intro: Create your avatar in a minute, then explore {grid} with a viewer such as Firestorm.
home_intro_closed: Log in to see your avatar's account on {grid}, change its password or delete it.
connect_step_install: Install an OpenSim viewer, such as Firestorm.
connect_step_grid: In Preferences, then OpenSim, add this login URI:
connect_step_login: Pick {grid} on the login screen, then log in with your avatar name and password.
login_intro: Use the avatar name and password of your viewer.
login_aside_text: Create an avatar in a minute. It comes dressed, with an inventory ready to use.
signup_intro: Your avatar name is how others see you in the grid.
signup_get_outfit: An avatar dressed in the default outfit
signup_get_inventory: An inventory with the usual folders
signup_get_viewer: Access from Firestorm or any OpenSim viewer
signup_closed: Account creation is closed on {grid}. Ask the grid administrator for an avatar.
account_created_notice: Your avatar is ready. Log in with your viewer using this name and password.
account_password_notice: Your password has changed. Use the new one in your viewer.
account_password_text: The viewer uses the new password at your next login.
account_delete_text: Removes the avatar and its inventory for good.
password_intro: The viewer uses the new password at your next login. Your other web sessions end.
password_tip_words: A few unrelated words are easy to remember and hard to guess.
password_tip_reuse: Use it for this grid only.
delete_intro: This deletes {name} for good. It cannot be undone.
error_server: The server could not answer. Try again in a moment.
hint_avatar_name_login: First and last name, as in your viewer.
hint_avatar_name_new: A first and a last name, {min} to {max} letters or digits each, for example Ada Lovelace. It cannot be changed later.
hint_password_new: At least {min} characters. A few unrelated words make a strong one.
error_name_two_words: Enter a first and a last name, separated by a space.
error_name_characters: Use letters and digits only, each name starting with a letter.
error_name_taken: An avatar already has this name.
error_password_characters: Use only characters you can type.
error_password_contains_name: Do not put the avatar name in the password.
error_credentials_invalid: The avatar name or the password is wrong.
error_account_online: Your avatar is in the grid. Log out of the viewer, wait a minute, then try again.
error_account_estate_owner: This avatar owns an estate. Ask the grid administrator to delete it.
error_account_privileged: This avatar has administrator rights. Ask the grid administrator to delete it.
error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
account_payment_text: Save a card once, then buy currency from your viewer.
payment_intro: Your viewer charges this card when you buy currency, after asking for your password.
payment_saved_notice: Your card is saved. Buy currency from your viewer.
payment_purchase_notice: Payment confirmed. Your balance goes up in the viewer in a moment.
payment_purchase_failed: Your bank did not confirm the payment, so nothing was charged. Buy again from your viewer.
payment_setup_failed: The card was not saved. Try again.
payment_how_viewer: In your viewer, open Buy currency from the balance at the top right.
payment_how_password: Enter the amount, then your avatar password to confirm.
payment_how_bank: If your bank asks for a check, the viewer gives a link to open in your browser.
payment_how_secure: Card details stay with Stripe: the grid never sees them.
viewer_payments_off: Buying currency is not available on {grid}.
viewer_amount_too_large: Buy at most {max} at a time.
viewer_rate_limited: Too many wrong passwords. Wait 15 minutes, then try again.
viewer_no_card: Save a card on your account page first. Open the link, then buy again.
viewer_action_required: Your bank asks you to confirm this payment. Open the link: your balance goes up once it is confirmed.
viewer_processing: The payment is being processed. Your balance goes up once it clears.
viewer_credit_failed: The payment went through, but the currency could not be credited. Contact the grid administrator.
viewer_unavailable: The purchase could not be made. Try again in a moment.
